risk_observations: CUDA capability probing may enter an exception path; that path must not fail due to unrelated logging/control-flow defects.
Explicit precision selection must be validated against hardware support and included in runtime provenance.
NaN/Inf detection is a production artifact-integrity boundary, not a warning-only condition.
CPU offload and LoRA can create device/dtype mismatch risk across model context transitions.
A proposed upstream optimization that skips consistency verification is not sufficient FA3 production evidence.
